relationship_to_prior_work: A new workload-conditioned study. It does not reopen or alter the frozen representative Spec-Bench 24Q conclusion (0.842x).

fixed_runtime.runtime: llama.cpp + Metal (installed build recorded at execution)
fixed_runtime.prompt_template:
Complete the following Python function. Return only the completed Python code, without Markdown fences.

{humaneval_prompt}

primary_confirmatory_comparison.pairing: Within each prompt and repetition; condition order randomized with seed 20260909 and prompt order randomized within repetition blocks.
primary_confirmatory_comparison.correctness_gate: 100% token-exact baseline/speculative pairs; any mismatch aborts the study.
primary_confirmatory_comparison.speed_estimator: Geometric mean of each prompt's geometric-mean paired speedup across three repetitions.
primary_confirmatory_comparison.uncertainty: 95% prompt bootstrap confidence interval with seed 20260910.
primary_confirmatory_comparison.energy_metric: Package J/output-token and baseline/speculative efficiency ratio.
profitable_regime_confirmed_if: the 95% prompt-bootstrap confidence interval lower bound is greater than 1.00
package J/output-token is lower under speculation
primary_confirmatory_comparison.otherwise: The code-conditioned profitable regime is not confirmed; no prompt may be removed using post-run acceptance or speed.

secondary_confidence_gating.role: Secondary runtime-policy analysis; it cannot rescue or redefine the primary fixed-k2 result.
secondary_confidence_gating.dataset_and_repetitions: The same frozen 30 prompts and three paired repetitions.
secondary_confidence_gating.reporting: Report both thresholds, exactness, speed, energy, acceptance, and all prompts. No threshold selection after observing results.

synthetic_ceiling.role: Controlled implementation ceiling only; never reported as real-workload performance.
synthetic_ceiling.llama_cpp_rates_mapping: For conditional probability p, pass unconditional per-position rates p,p^2 for k=2.
synthetic_ceiling.reporting: Observed acceptance, accepted tokens/round, median and geometric-mean speedup, and interpolated empirical break-even threshold.

stop_rule: After the primary code comparison, registered p-min secondary analysis, and corrected synthetic ceiling are complete, stop M4 experimentation regardless of outcome. Do not change model, runtime, k, acceptance rule, dataset membership, or correctness standard.
